company.name: inFeedo
company.shortDescription: InFeedo is a SaaS-based analytics company that develops an employee engagement platform for enterprises.
company.description:
InFeedo is a SaaS-based people predictive analytics company that is helping over 100 enterprises, such as GE, Puma, Kotak, Tata, Airtel, redefine employee engagement. It is currently focused on its flagship product Amber, an artificial intelligence-enabled bot that helps CHROs manage employee engagement, predict attrition, and measure company culture in real-time. Amber connects with employees across organizations to collect actionable insights for HR, in order to enhance employee engagement, curb potential attrition, and gain a real-time sense of overall sentiment. 

The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Gurgaon, India.
